# GitHub Copilot Instructions — IFRS-AI-Inspector

## Identity
IFRS-AI-Inspector is a NAAIL research prototype for standards-aware assurance, IFRS reasoning, knowledge graphs, RAG/GraphRAG, digital twins and verifiable accounting AI. Researcher: Saeid Homayoun, ORCID 0000-0002-2536-0446.

## Engineering priorities
- Keep deterministic accounting checks separate from probabilistic narration.
- Preserve source provenance and evidence links.
- Prefer explicit schemas, typed interfaces and testable rule functions.
- Add regression tests when changing standards mappings, calculations or agent behavior.
- Never silently weaken verification gates.

## Scientific protocol
Literature/standards validation → competing hypotheses → ERA-style empirical or validation design → controlled model comparison → adversarial review → robustness/falsification → temporal/OOS checks → Chain-of-Evidence → Human Gate.

## Professional safeguards
- Do not invent IFRS/IAS/ISA/PCAOB requirements.
- Do not imply official validation by IFRS Foundation, regulators or audit firms.
- Treat generated reasoning as assistance, not professional authority.
- Maintain human review for material accounting judgments.

## IP and rights
- Do not publish patent-sensitive architecture, credentials, restricted standards text or confidential datasets.
- Respect third-party licenses and trademarks.
- Public GitHub disclosure is not a patent filing.

## Documentation
For material changes, update README, CITATION.cff, architecture/method notes, tests and limitations as appropriate.
